methods.ranking: 22-month positive-month count, then worst monthly P&L, worse of 2025/2026 P&L, total P&L, Nov-to-date P&L
methods.comparison: same symbols with same/within-1-hour UTC entry times and similar timeframe, direction, indicators, regime, duration; monthly P&L similarity. Optional 4/5 overlap only if extremely high correlation
methods.suppress_when_same_assets: 60% exact hours, >=90% within 1h, structural similarity >=0.82 and (monthly corr >=0.88 or profit/loss month sign agree >=90%) OR structural >=0.76 and corr >=0.97
methods.suppress_when_4of5_asset_overlap: structural >=0.91, monthly corr >=0.97, monthly sign agreement >=95%
methods.direct_only: Every removed configuration compared directly with final retained representative. No transitive single-linkage overmerging.
methods.disclaimer: In-sample monthly-return similarity over only 22 months; not trade-by-trade correlation or proven independence.
